pages.text: The gentlest biome, and a good place to arrive: rolling blue-green meadows under scattered $(l:glowing_woods)Glowwood$(/l) trees, dotted with $(l:plants_and_food)Moonblossom$(/l) and glow fern.
Herds of $(l:native_fauna)Lumen Grazers$(/l) graze the open ground, and $(l:native_fauna)Lantern Beetles$(/l) drift between the flowers — a calm first foothold before the stranger biomes.
